categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in the textile industry, including yarn spinning, weaving, non-woven fabric, dyeing and finishing, garment manufacturing, and apparel production. It also engages in chemical fiber manufacturing, international trade, general investment, and real estate development and leasing. The business segments cover upstream and midstream textile production as well as diversified investments in related industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced spinning technologies including compact spinning, composite spinning, and fancy spinning to produce differentiated yarn products. In chemical fibers, it develops high-functionality fibers such as moisture-wicking, antibacterial, biodegradable fibers, and specialty polyester materials. Production processes include polyester polymerization, fiber spinning, and finishing with a focus on automation, flexibility, and environmental sustainability certifications like ISO9001 and ISO14000.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include textile manufacturers, garment brands, and industrial fabric users primarily in Taiwan, Southeast Asia, Japan, Korea, China, Europe, and the Americas. The company serves downstream apparel brands and industrial sectors requiring functional and sustainable textile materials. It targets diversified brand clients to reduce dependency on single markets and emphasizes environmentally friendly product lines to meet global brand demands.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with significant manufacturing facilities in Tainan and overseas production subsidiaries in Vietnam and Singapore. Its sales markets span Taiwan, Southeast Asia, Japan, Korea, China, Europe, and the Americas. The company is actively expanding its presence in key ASEAN countries to strengthen global supply chain positioning.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the upstream and midstream segments of the textile supply chain, producing raw yarns, chemical fibers, and semi-finished textile materials. It integrates vertically with downstream garment manufacturers and brand customers through close collaboration and supply chain integration. It also engages in trading and investment activities related to the textile industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing high-value, differentiated, and environmentally sustainable textile products such as recycled fibers, biodegradable materials, and functional yarns. The company invests in automation and production flexibility to improve efficiency and responsiveness. It pursues vertical integration with brand customers and expands R&D collaborations with academic institutions to innovate in polyester modification and specialty fiber technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of yarns, chemical fibers, and polyester raw materials to textile manufacturers and industrial customers. The company also earns income from investments and diversified business operations including real estate development and retail. It focuses on maintaining stable sales channels through vertical integration and expanding environmentally certified product lines.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces intense competition from manufacturers in China, India, Turkey, and Southeast Asia, especially due to overcapacity and low-price competition. It positions itself as a high-quality, flexible, and innovation-driven textile producer with strong vertical integration and environmental sustainability credentials. The company leverages Taiwan's advantages and global supply chain diversification to maintain competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the consolidated revenue was approximately NT$17.19 billion with a net loss of about NT$516 million, reflecting challenges from global market demand and pricing pressures. The company has a substantial asset base of nearly NT$49 billion and equity of about NT$29.5 billion. It is undergoing strategic adjustments to improve profitability and expects cautious market recovery and growth in the coming year.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes product differentiation through environmental sustainability, including organic cotton, recycled fibers, biodegradable yarns, and functional textiles with moisture-wicking and antibacterial properties. It offers flexible production capabilities and rapid response to market changes, supported by vertical integration with brand customers. Its commitment to quality, innovation, and supply chain intelligence provides competitive advantages in global markets.
